sloka: वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ कश्यपम् ।द्विजांश्च सर्वप्रवरानश्वमेधपुरस्कृतान् ।। ७.९१.२ ॥
transliteration: vasiṣṭhaṁ vāmadevaṁ ca jābālimatha kaśyapam ।dvijāṁśca sarvapravarānaśvamedhapuraskṛtān ।। 7.91.2 ॥

translations.english: He spoke about inviting Vasistha, Vamadeva, Jabali, Kashyapa, and all other chief Brahmins who are appointed for the Ashwamedha sacrifice.
